_comment: Copy this file to webapp_config.json (gitignored) or let the webapp create it on the first 'Set as default' tap. All keys are optional — missing keys fall back to the defaults documented in src/webapp_config.py.
_comment_auth_token: Empty string = auth gate OFF (the default). Run scripts/gen_token.py to generate a strong token; the webapp will then require Authorization: Bearer <token> on every API call from non-loopback callers. See README → 'Optional: bearer-token auth'.
_comment_polish_prompts: polish_prompt_default picks one of the entries in config/polish_prompts.json (committed). Add new entries there to expose more polish styles in the webapp + tk window — no code change needed.
